name: PCSX2 v1.7.5849 x86-64 data memory: 155 MiB must land in one of eleven 256 MiB-spaced windows near the emulator text
component: PCSX2 SysMemory::AllocateVirtualMemory, data-memory allocation before PR #11734

request.displacement_reference: PCSX2 AllocateVirtualMemory text address rounded down to a 256 MiB boundary

required_postconditions: the 155 MiB data mapping starts at codeBase + n*256MiB for one n in {-6,-5,...,4}
the returned address equals the selected candidate; a kernel relocation is rejected
the later 305 MiB recompiler mapping must satisfy the same executable-relative policy

failure_sink.description: after all eleven exact placements fail, startup reports 'Failed to map data memory at an acceptable location', releases the memory map and returns false

extraction_limitations: the schema carries the maximum displacement but cannot express the discrete set of eleven candidates
a reusable host profile cannot know where a future PCSX2 process image will land; evaluating the candidate ranges requires a launch-time reference
the v1.7.5849 constants are 155 MiB data plus 305 MiB code, 460 MiB total; the nearby source comment says approximately 640 MiB and is not used as evidence

x_campaign.rationale: none of the measured profiles contains the future executable placement needed to derive the eleven candidate addresses; a confident supported or unsupported verdict would invent evidence
